title: Houston Brewery Tours
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
The minimum age is 21 years. Everyone must wear closed-toed shoes as glass mugs could break if someone drops one while drinking.

The tour is customizeable with 3 locations. One location will be the St. Arnold Brewery. The customer can then choose 2 more breweries in either the Eado District or Midtown, Heights, or the 2nd and 6th Ward.
Parents and guardians need to provide booster seats for children 2 years old and under
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Houston's best brewery tour! Behind-the-scenes access, curated beer flights, and local insights. Taste the city's craft beer scene like never before!
